name: Sita Varma
description: Sita Varma is a respected engineer from Avishkar who secretly led a double life as the masked underground racer Spitfire.

summary.text: Sita Varma is a respected engineer from Avishkar who secretly led a double life as the masked underground racer Spitfire.

citations.text: "Sita Varma". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

bio.text: Her mother was killed in the New Phyrexian Invasion, and Sita put her engineering to work as Spitfire.

citations.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Her strict father, Mohar, expected her to marry advantageously, while she hid her racing suit and slipped out to the Aether Rangers' garage.

citations.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

bio.text: She co-led the Aether Rangers with Pia Nalaar in the Ghirapur Grand Prix, and she and Chandra found mutual respect.

citations.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Near the finish a trap set in a coup by her father stopped her and revealed her identity.

citations.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citations.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

bio.text: She then broke free, fought as Team Avishkar with Chandra and Pia, and was knocked out by Jace while rescuing them, before Nissa and Elspeth saved them.

status.text: Sita is alive and drives taxis in Ghirapur, ignoring her jailed father.

timeline.summary: Sita, the underground racing queen Spitfire, struggles over the estate wall and sneaks home.
timeline.quote: Ghirapur's current queen of underground racing, the mysterious and tough and seemingly unbeatable Spitfire, is having some trouble climbing the wall

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita hides her racing suit and changes into the dress her father expects.
timeline.quote: She hides her racing suit in her nightstand and hurries to change into the dress he expects of her.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar, who has not shed his consul's trappings, doles out strict expectations to Sita.
timeline.quote: Mohar Varma, Sita's father, has not yet shed the stations and signifiers of his former office

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita corrects her father that the plane is now called Avishkar and argues about tradition.
timeline.quote: It's Avishkar now

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar hurls the radio across the room at the mention of Gonti.
timeline.quote: The moment Gonti's name is announced on the radio, Mohar hurls it across the room.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar says Sita must be married advantageously, and then notices aether fumes on her.
timeline.quote: We must find you an advantageous marriage somewhere

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita puts on her Spitfire mask.
timeline.quote: Sita puts on the mask.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire arrives at the Aether Rangers' garage where screens show Chandra Nalaar.
timeline.quote: Chandra Nalaar's face is smiling across all their screens.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia Nalaar reveals she has upgraded Spitfire's racer with advanced aether systems.
timeline.quote: A ten-cylinder aether inverter system, two separate cyclonic mitigators

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 1: The Dashing and the Desperate" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita arranges a cover story to leave her father's house for the race.
timeline.quote: If her father is to believe that she's needed elsewhere, he must see that she is needed elsewhere.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Lalan arrives and pretends Sita has an internship at her atelier.
timeline.quote: I just thought I'd swing by to pick up Sita for her internship.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar approves the internship and embraces Sita.
timeline.quote: When you return, we'll stop by your mother's memorial and show her your creations.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire passes Far Fortune and a shark-man chordatan in the pits.
timeline.quote: Of all the other racers, Fortune is the only one that really intimidates Spitfire.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia gives Spitfire a new aether-powered racing suit.
timeline.quote: Beneath it, she finds a new racing suit.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia explains the suit's aether capsules grant two seconds of enhanced speed.
timeline.quote: With one of those capsules in your system, you'll be quicker than the gods for about two seconds.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia admits the suit was sized for someone else, implying Chandra.
timeline.quote: It's because I'm taller than her, isn't it?

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: An Endrider throws a hooked chain at Spitfire's ride, and she narrowly evades it.
timeline.quote: The fierce young vagabond throws a hooked chain toward Spitfire's ride.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire uses an aether canister to slow time for herself.
timeline.quote: Spitfire twists the canister and enters the infinite.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire uses auxiliary thrusters to leap past a spectral arm of the Speed Demons.
timeline.quote: Flipping a switch on the steering wheel activates the auxiliary thrusters.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire shoots through the gap in the collapsing platform.
timeline.quote: Spitfire shoots through it.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire emerges through an Omenpath onto Amonkhet to find the Speed Demons took first place and she is second.
timeline.quote: And Spitfire realizes it's not her.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 2: Pit Stop" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire slices a cannonball in two so that it crashes into Voyager racers.
timeline.quote: A bladed arc of lightning shoots from the grille to slice the cannonball in two.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire glares at Chandra as she passes her.
timeline.quote: That's why Spitfire makes a point of glaring back as she passes Avishkar's favorite daughter.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire finds herself in sixth place and renews her resolve for the Aetherspark.
timeline.quote: Sixth place.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire launches off a god statue's spear to pass the goblins.
timeline.quote: she launches off the tip of the old god's spear.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A fireball blasts away glitch ghosts that were attacking Spitfire, though its heat scorches her.
timeline.quote: Until a scintillating fireball blasts them away, replacing one threat with another

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita secretly thanks her rescuer in her cockpit.
timeline.quote: Beneath the mask, in the privacy of her own ride, Sita mutters her thanks.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: An Omenpath opens at the end of the Amonkhet track, leading to Muraganda.
timeline.quote: Up ahead, an Omenpath ripples at the end of the track.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A huge dust storm swallows the Guidelight Voyagers as the others flee through the Omenpath.
timeline.quote: In the rearview mirror, Spitfire watches the Guidelight Voyagers, automatons captained by Mendicant Core, as they're swallowed up in the storm.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Kari Zev tells Vin that Spitfire knows where to find her if she wants to prove herself.
timeline.quote: She knows where to find me if she really wants to prove herself

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire is awed by Muraganda's giant flowers and suspended rain.
timeline.quote: No amount of daydreaming could have prepared her for Muraganda.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire sees Pia talking to the dead Champion who has been raised.
timeline.quote: Her attention is focused on a member of the Champions: a dark-skinned man with gold-adorned dreadlocks.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia explains that Khuru is the first raised in the race after giving his life for Zahur.
timeline.quote: That young man, Khuru, is the first one they've raised during this race.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 3: Go!" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire waits for the Amonkheti to cut through a tree rather than use Chandra's tunnel.
timeline.quote: she throws the ride into reverse and waits for the Amonkheti to slice through the tree.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire sees the raised Khuru riding with Basri and Zahur.
timeline.quote: the man who died saving Zahur only yesterday

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A moonfall quake begins and the Amonkheti chariot hippo bolts for shelter.
timeline.quote: Sure enough, the gentle tremble beneath them intensifies into a hungry growl from the earth.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Spitfire recalls the Phyrexian arm piercing Ghirapur and fighting her fused guards.
timeline.quote: Two years ago, she'd woken up one morning to see a massive, porcelain-plated arm piercing the city she knew and loved.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Pia orders Spitfire to pull into the valley and Spitfire obeys.
timeline.quote: She turns toward the valley.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire injects aether and slips through the raiders and dinosaur to take the lead.
timeline.quote: She jams another canister of aether into the port on the suit's shoulder and twists.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra's ride is crushed by a dinosaur and Spitfire sees her clinging to a raptor.
timeline.quote: The younger Nalaar's ride is crushed underfoot by a rampaging dinosaur.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sita and her father are caught in traffic as the Invasion Tree crashes into Ishani's house.
timeline.quote: Twenty minutes later, they were only half a mile down the road, and Sita watched a limb of the Invasion Tree crash into Ishani's house.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire switches off her radio and leaves Chandra behind.
timeline.quote: With a flick of a switch, Spitfire switches off her radio.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 4: Little-Guy Shortcuts" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire races through the Omenpath into Ghirapur, leading the field to the finish.
timeline.quote: As her ride howls through the Omenpath, there is nothing to hamper her.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire and Winter go chassis to chassis near the finish.
timeline.quote: The Aether Ranger's front bumper scrapes against the Speed Demon's driver-side door.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Winter fires blue flame at Spitfire and bursts into flame.
timeline.quote: Winter shoots a gout of blue flame at her.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: A golden filigree safety wall shoots up in the track, ahead of the finish line.
timeline.quote: Shooting up in the middle of the track is an intricate wall of golden filigree

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Spitfire crashes into the wall, knocked dazed.
timeline.quote: Stars explode across the back of her eyes

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Half of Spitfire's mask falls into her lap, revealing her to guards as Sita.
timeline.quote: For there in her lap is half of Spitfire's mask.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Guards drag her before her father, who demands to know the meaning of this.
timeline.quote: Sita! Are you all right? What is the meaning of this? You could have been killed out there!

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Mohar orders his daughter taken to a doctor and tells his men to keep it secret.
timeline.quote: Tell no one of this.

citation.work: Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line
citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 5: First Over the Line" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra sees that the golden wall trapped racers including the Aether Rangers.
timeline.quote: The Aether Rangers aren't the only ones who got caught in the trap, either.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Guarded by her father, Sita plans to use her last aether canister to cross the finish line.
timeline.quote: Most important of all, she still has one canister left.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita injects aether instead of racing to the Aetherspark.
timeline.quote: Canister meets port; aether meets bloodstream.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita breaks free and disarms the guards to save Pia.
timeline.quote: Sita throws off the hands keeping her in place, rushes past her hapless father, and dives straight for Pia Nalaar.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Pia and Sita fight together as Team Avishkar.
timeline.quote: Engine, wheels, and transmission. Chandra, Pia, and Sita.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Nissa finds Chandra, Pia and Sita collapsed.
timeline.quote: Crumpled before the remnants of a great ship: Chandra, Pia, and that other girl she'd seen on the broadcast.

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Sita reveals her father Mohar is in jail for attempting a coup.
timeline.quote: Considering he's in jail, I think he has worse things to worry about

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Chandra hugs Sita and introduces Nissa.
timeline.quote: You really saved me and mom out there!

citation.text: "Aetherdrift | Episode 6: The Bloodless Revolution" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jan 2025.

timeline.summary: Jace Beleren mind controls several racers in an attempt to recover Loot and knocks out Chandra, Pia Nalaar and Sita Varma.
timeline.quote: were mind controlled by Jace Beleren in an attempt to recover Loot , while he rendered Chandra and Pia Nalaar and Sita Varma unconscious.

citation.text: "Ghirapur Grand Prix", section "Second Grand Prix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Madhu dies in the New Phyrexian Invasion, leaving Mohar to raise Sita alone.
timeline.quote: Madhu died in the New Phyrexian Invasion , leaving Mohar to raise his daughter alone.

citation.text: "Mohar Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The trap stops the leading teams and reveals Sita as captain; the coup fails and Mohar is jailed.
timeline.quote: it failed, and Mohar was sent to jail.

citation.text: "Mohar Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sita's mother is killed in the New Phyrexian Invasion, and Sita puts her engineering to work as Spitfire.
timeline.quote: Sita's mother was killed in the New Phyrexian Invasion

citation.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sita and Pia Nalaar co-lead the Aether Rangers in the Ghirapur Grand Prix; Sita and Chandra find mutual respect.
timeline.quote: They later found mutual respect after realizing that they were much alike

citation.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A coup by her father stops Sita near the finish and reveals her identity.
timeline.quote: she was stopped by a sudden coup started by her father, which caused her identity to be revealed

citation.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sita rescues Chandra and Pia from Jace Beleren but all three are knocked unconscious; Nissa Revane rescues them and Elspeth Tirel heals them.
timeline.quote: all three were rendered unconscious by the mind mage, only being rescued by Nissa Revane and healed by Elspeth Tirel

citation.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the race Sita becomes the city's fastest taxi driver, ignoring her incarcerated father.
timeline.quote: she became the city's fastest taxi driver

citation.text: "Sita Varma", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
